mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe where recommend = 1 AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT r.*, m.nickname, c.category_name FROM recipe r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id JOIN recipe_category rc ON r.recipe_id = rc.recipe_id JOIN category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id WHERE recipe_id = #{num}
SELECT r.* FROM recipe WHERE r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_date DESC
SELECT DISTINCT r.*, m.nickname FROM recipe r JOIN ingredient i ON r.recipe_id = i.recipe_id JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id WHERE i.ingredient_name LIKE #{pattern}

SELECT DISTINCT r.*, c.category_name FROM recipe_view r LEFT JOIN recipe_category rc ON r.recipe_id = rc.recipe_id LEFT JOIN category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
AND REPLACE(c.category_name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(#{category}, ' ', '')
AND CAST(REPLACE(r.cooking_time, '분', '') AS UNSIGNED) <= #{maxCookTime}
ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(r.cooking_time, '분', '') AS UNSIGNED) ASC
ORDER BY r.created_date DESC

SELECT f.food_id AS foodId, f.food_name AS foodName, f.category_id AS categoryId FROM food f JOIN category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id WHERE REPLACE(c.category_name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(#{categoryName}, ' ', '') ORDER BY f.food_name ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food f JOIN category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id WHERE REPLACE(c.category_name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(#{categoryName}, ' ', '')
SELECT r.*, m.nickname FROM recipe r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 5
select r.*, m.nickname from recipe r join member m on r.member_id = m.member_id where recommend = 1 order by r.created_date desc, r.recipe_id desc LIMIT 10

SELECT r.recipe_id, r.title, r.cooking_time, r.view_count, r.created_date, r.updated_date, r.thumbnail, r.status, cat.category_id, cat.category_name, parent.category_id AS parent_category_id, parent.category_name AS parent_category_name, m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickName, i.ingredient_id, i.ingredient_name, i.quantity, i.unit, i.type, co.cook_order_id, co.cook_order, co.cook_image, co.description FROM recipe r JOIN member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id Left Join recipe_category rc ON r.recipe_id = rc.recipe_id Left Join category cat ON rc.category_id = cat.category_id Left Join category parent ON cat.parent_id = parent.category_id LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON r.recipe_id = i.recipe_id LEFT JOIN cook_order co ON r.recipe_id = co.recipe_id WHERE r.recipe_id = #{recipeId}
SELECT food_id AS foodId, food_name AS foodName FROM food ORDER BY food_name
